title: Integrate Razorpay payment button and restructure website layout

requirements.text: Replace the existing UPI payment flow with the Razorpay payment button using the script tag with payment_button_id 'pl_SIrXp6zPDOixDu' from https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/payment-button.js
acceptanceCriteria: Razorpay payment button script is loaded asynchronously
Payment button renders with the correct payment_button_id
Previous UPI payment logic is replaced with Razorpay integration
Payment button is visually integrated into the existing CTA sections

requirements.text: Update all pricing displays from the current price to ₹299 throughout the website including the hero section, pricing cards, bottom CTA bar, and constants file
acceptanceCriteria: All instances of the offer price display ₹299
Any strikethrough or original pricing remains consistent with the new offer price

requirements.text: Restructure the landing page layout to move the testimonials/reviews section below the main content and features section, ensuring a logical information hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: Testimonials section appears after the features section
Content flow follows: Hero → Features → Testimonials → CTA
Visual hierarchy is maintained with proper spacing
Mobile responsiveness is preserved in the new layout

requirements.text: Enhance the overall website design to professional standards with improved typography hierarchy, consistent spacing system, refined color palette, professional shadows and borders, and polished micro-interactions
acceptanceCriteria: Typography uses a clear hierarchy with consistent font sizes and weights
Spacing follows a consistent scale (e.g., 8px base unit)
Color palette uses professional, harmonious colors with proper contrast
UI elements have refined shadows, borders, and hover states
Overall design feels polished and trustworthy
Layout uses proper white space and breathing room
All sections have cohesive visual treatment

constraints: Preserve existing Meta Pixel tracking functionality
Maintain mobile responsiveness across all breakpoints
Keep the existing simulated live purchase counter functionality
Do not modify backend/main.mo or backend architecture
Do not change Internet Identity authentication implementation
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond payment integration and layout restructuring
Changing the core product offering (Canva Pro access)
Modifying the Meta Pixel tracking configuration
